chapter_note: Strongly substratic chapter on the Sun/Third Messenger as cosmic ambassador. Core teaching: two mysteries revealed in the sun — its rising matches the First Man's emergence (first contest); its setting matches the consummation of the cosmos and the last Extraction. Editorial layers are confined to the opening dialogue formula (i=1), a closing hortatory pivot (i=44–49), and the closing disciple-reaction frame (i=50). The 'Election' (ⲧⲥⲁⲧⲧ/ⲍⲱⲱϩ) here is cosmological — the choosing-out of Light at sunset/cosmic end — not ecclesial 'Elect.' The vocabulary scorer's manichaean_ecclesial hits on i=3, 14, 19, 30, 42 are false positives triggered by ⲙⲩⲥⲧⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ vocabulary in cosmological context. Editorial fatigue score correctly identifies the late-chapter hortatory cluster.
